description:
Attractive Detached Family Home with Stunning Countryside Views

A most attractive detached family home occupying a generous plot in a sought-after rural setting, enjoying far-reaching views across open rolling countryside towards Skiddaw and the Northern Fells. The property offers spacious and well-presented accommodation throughout, combining period character with comfortable modern living.

The accommodation includes two generous reception rooms, each providing excellent living and entertaining space, together with a recently extended kitchen which forms a practical and welcoming heart of the home. Period features, high ceilings and wood-burning stoves add warmth and character, creating an appealing balance of charm and functionality.

To the first floor there are three double bedrooms, a study and a family bathroom, providing flexible accommodation well suited to family buyers, those working from home or anyone seeking additional guest space.

In addition, the property benefits from a range of useful outbuildings and a garage, offering excellent storage and workshop potential. The garage is suitable for a small vehicle and, together with the outbuildings, provides versatile space for hobbies, garden equipment, bicycles or general household storage.

Externally, the property is complemented by well-maintained, well-stocked gardens and ample off-street parking, with the generous grounds enhancing the sense of privacy and space. The gardens provide an attractive setting from which to enjoy the surrounding countryside and the property's exceptional outlook.

Aspatria provides a useful range of everyday facilities including local shops, public houses and a junior school, making it a convenient choice for a variety of buyers.

The town benefits from excellent bus and rail connections, together with easy access to the A596, offering straightforward routes to Maryport, Workington and Cockermouth, as well as east towards Wigton and the border city of Carlisle.

Its position between the Solway Coast National Landscape and the Lake District National Park offers superb access to coastal walks, countryside pursuits and some of Cumbria's most celebrated scenery, while still remaining within reach of excellent regional amenities.

Directions Take the A595 past Wigton turn left onto the B5301 to Aspatria. Proceed through the town and take a right turn onto the B5299 signposted Mealsgate. The property can be found on the right-hand side just before the turning into Lake Side Golf Course.

Services Gas central heating updated 5 years ago, with mains electric and water being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Drainage is to a septic tank the seller has commissioned a report confirming the tank complies with current regulations.
